parole.significato: in a nutshell; briefly, in a concise or condensed form; in a few words
parole.testo: Calque of English in a nutshell (“in summary; briefly”), literally i (“in”) + et (“a”) + nøtteskall (“nutshell”). First attested in 1922. The English expression is recorded from 1822; diachronic corpus evidence supports its subsequent adoption into Norwegian as a phraseological borrowing from Englis
